high_level_description: stc brand style, a dramatic aerial cityscape of Riyadh at sunrise featuring two modern skyscrapers.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A sky with a warm gradient from yellow to light blue, a hazy urban skyline of high-rise buildings extending into the distance, golden lens flare from the sun behind the towers.

elements.desc: A dark tower on the left and a white tower with a geometric triangular window pattern on the right, both prominent in the foreground.
White Arabic text in the bottom right corner.
